description: Gives the user a link to an interactive map of a style, served by this server on their machine, so there is no viewer page to write, no web server to start and no browser to open for them. Given a file, the map follows it and redraws when the file changes. Given the style as an object, the map shows a changed style when you pass it together with the link, as link. Pass the style as an object, a URL or a file path.

link.description: A link that this tool gave before for a style passed as an object. The map there then shows this style, and a page that has it open redraws.

path.description: Path to a style JSON file, relative to the directory the server runs in.

style.description: The style as a JSON object.

url.description: URL of a style JSON document.

name: preview_style
title: Preview style
